content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Iam lucis orto sídere,
content.english: Now in the sun's new dawning ray,

content.latin: Deum precémur súpplices,
content.english: Lowly of heart, our God we pray

content.latin: Ut in diúrnis áctibus
content.english: That he from harm may keep us free

content.latin: Nos servet a nocéntibus.
content.english: In all the deeds this day shall see.

content.latin: Linguam refrénans témperet,
content.english: May fear of him our tongues restrain,

content.latin: Ne litis horror ínsonet:
content.english: Lest strife unguarded speech should stain:

content.latin: Visum fovéndo cóntegat,
content.english: His favouring care our guardian be,

content.latin: Ne vanitátes háuriat.
content.english: Lest our eyes feed on vanity.

content.latin: Sint pura cordis íntima,
content.english: May every heart be pure from sin

content.latin: Absístat et vecórdia;
content.english: And folly find no place therein:

content.latin: Carnis terat supérbiam
content.english: Scant need of food, excess denied,

content.latin: Potus cibíque párcitas.
content.english: Wear down in us the body's pride.

content.latin: Ut, cum dies abscésserit,
content.english: That when the light of day is gone,

content.latin: Noctémque sors redúxerit,
content.english: And night in course shall follow on.

content.latin: Mundi per abstinéntiam
content.english: We, free from cares the world affords,

content.latin: Ipsi canámus glóriam.
content.english: May chant the praise that is our Lord's.

content.latin: Deo Patri sit glória,
content.english: All laud to God the Father be,

content.latin: Eiúsque soli Fílio,
content.english: All praise, Eternal Son, to thee:

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
content.english: All glory, as is ever meet,

content.latin: Nunc et per omne sǽculum.
content.english: To God the holy Paraclete.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Ne discédas a me, * Dómine: quóniam tribulátio próxima est: quóniam non est qui ádiuvet.
content.english: Ant. Depart not from me, * O Lord, for tribulation is very near; for there is none to help me.

segments.t: Ant.
Ne discédas a me, * Dómine: quóniam tribulátio próxima est: quóniam non est qui ádiuvet.
Psalmus 21(2-12)

content.latin: 21:2 Deus, Deus meus, réspice in me: quare me dereliquísti? * longe a salúte mea verba delictórum meórum.
content.english: 21:2 O God my God, look upon me: why hast thou forsaken me? * Far from my salvation are the words of my sins.

segments.t: Deus, Deus meus, réspice in me: quare me dereliquísti? * longe a salúte mea verba delictórum meórum.

content.latin: 21:3 Deus meus, clamábo per diem, et non exáudies: * et nocte, et non ad insipiéntiam mihi.
content.english: 21:3 O my God, I shall cry by day, and thou wilt not hear: * and by night, and it shall not be reputed as folly in me.

segments.t: Deus meus, clamábo per diem, et non exáudies: * et nocte, et non ad insipiéntiam mihi.

content.latin: 21:4 Tu autem in sancto hábitas, * laus Israël.
content.english: 21:4 But thou dwellest in the holy place, * the praise of Israel.

segments.t: Tu autem in sancto hábitas, * laus Israël.

content.latin: 21:5 In te speravérunt patres nostri: * speravérunt, et liberásti eos.
content.english: 21:5 In thee have our fathers hoped: * they have hoped, and thou hast delivered them.

segments.t: In te speravérunt patres nostri: * speravérunt, et liberásti eos.

content.latin: 21:6 Ad te clamavérunt, et salvi facti sunt: * in te speravérunt, et non sunt confúsi.
content.english: 21:6 They cried to thee, and they were saved: * they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

segments.t: Ad te clamavérunt, et salvi facti sunt: * in te speravérunt, et non sunt confúsi.

content.latin: 21:7 Ego autem sum vermis, et non homo: * oppróbrium hóminum, et abiéctio plebis.
content.english: 21:7 But I am a worm, and no man: * the reproach of men, and the outcast of the people.

segments.t: Ego autem sum vermis, et non homo: * oppróbrium hóminum, et abiéctio plebis.

content.latin: 21:8 Omnes vidéntes me, derisérunt me: * locúti sunt lábiis, et movérunt caput.
content.english: 21:8 All they that saw me have laughed me to scorn: * they have spoken with the lips, and wagged the head.

segments.t: Omnes vidéntes me, derisérunt me: * locúti sunt lábiis, et movérunt caput.

content.latin: 21:9 Sperávit in Dómino, erípiat eum: * salvum fáciat eum, quóniam vult eum.
content.english: 21:9 He hoped in the Lord, let him deliver him: * let him save him, seeing he delighteth in him.

segments.t: Sperávit in Dómino, erípiat eum: * salvum fáciat eum, quóniam vult eum.

content.latin: 21:10 Quóniam tu es, qui extraxísti me de ventre: * spes mea ab ubéribus matris meæ. In te proiéctus sum ex útero:
content.english: 21:10 For thou art he that hast drawn me out of the womb: * my hope from the breasts of my mother. I was cast upon thee from the womb.

segments.t: Quóniam tu es, qui extraxísti me de ventre: * spes mea ab ubéribus matris meæ. In te proiéctus sum ex útero:

content.latin: 21:11 De ventre matris meæ Deus meus es tu, * ne discésseris a me:
content.english: 21:11 From my mother’s womb thou art my God, * depart not from me.

segments.t: De ventre matris meæ Deus meus es tu, * ne discésseris a me:

content.latin: 21:12 Quóniam tribulátio próxima est: * quóniam non est qui ádiuvet.
content.english: 21:12 For tribulation is very near: * for there is none to help me.

segments.t: Quóniam tribulátio próxima est: * quóniam non est qui ádiuvet.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 21(13-23)

content.latin: 21:13 Circumdedérunt me vítuli multi: * tauri pingues obsedérunt me.
content.english: 21:13 Many calves have surrounded me: * fat bulls have besieged me.

segments.t: Circumdedérunt me vítuli multi: * tauri pingues obsedérunt me.

content.latin: 21:14 Aperuérunt super me os suum, * sicut leo rápiens et rúgiens.
content.english: 21:14 They have opened their mouths against me, * as a lion ravening and roaring.

segments.t: Aperuérunt super me os suum, * sicut leo rápiens et rúgiens.

content.latin: 21:15 Sicut aqua effúsus sum: * et dispérsa sunt ómnia ossa mea.
content.english: 21:15 I am poured out like water; * and all my bones are scattered.

segments.t: Sicut aqua effúsus sum: * et dispérsa sunt ómnia ossa mea.

content.latin: 21:15 Factum est cor meum tamquam cera liquéscens * in médio ventris mei.
content.english: 21:15 My heart is become like wax melting * in the midst of my bowels.

segments.t: Factum est cor meum tamquam cera liquéscens * in médio ventris mei.

content.latin: 21:16 Áruit tamquam testa virtus mea, et lingua mea adhǽsit fáucibus meis: * et in púlverem mortis deduxísti me.
content.english: 21:16 My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue hath cleaved to my jaws: * and thou hast brought me down into the dust of death.

segments.t: Áruit tamquam testa virtus mea, et lingua mea adhǽsit fáucibus meis: * et in púlverem mortis deduxísti me.

content.latin: 21:17 Quóniam circumdedérunt me canes multi: * concílium malignántium obsédit me.
content.english: 21:17 For many dogs have encompassed me: * the council of the malignant hath besieged me.

segments.t: Quóniam circumdedérunt me canes multi: * concílium malignántium obsédit me.

content.latin: 21:17 Fodérunt manus meas et pedes meos: * dinumeravérunt ómnia ossa mea.
content.english: 21:17 They have dug my hands and feet. * They have numbered all my bones.

segments.t: Fodérunt manus meas et pedes meos: * dinumeravérunt ómnia ossa mea.

content.latin: 21:18 Ipsi vero consideravérunt et inspexérunt me: * divisérunt sibi vestiménta mea, et super vestem meam misérunt sortem.
content.english: 21:18 And they have looked and stared upon me. * They parted my garments amongst them; and upon my vesture they cast lots.

segments.t: Ipsi vero consideravérunt et inspexérunt me: * divisérunt sibi vestiménta mea, et super vestem meam misérunt sortem.

content.latin: 21:20 Tu autem, Dómine, ne elongáveris auxílium tuum a me: * ad defensiónem meam cónspice.
content.english: 21:20 But thou, O Lord, remove not thy help to a distance from me; * look towards my defence.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, ne elongáveris auxílium tuum a me: * ad defensiónem meam cónspice.

content.latin: 21:21 Érue a frámea, Deus, ánimam meam: * et de manu canis únicam meam:
content.english: 21:21 Deliver, O God, my soul from the sword: * my only one from the hand of the dog.

segments.t: Érue a frámea, Deus, ánimam meam: * et de manu canis únicam meam:

content.latin: 21:22 Salva me ex ore leónis: * et a córnibus unicórnium humilitátem meam.
content.english: 21:22 Save me from the lion’s mouth; * and my lowness from the horns of the unicorns.

segments.t: Salva me ex ore leónis: * et a córnibus unicórnium humilitátem meam.

content.latin: 21:23 Narrábo nomen tuum frátribus meis: * in médio ecclésiæ laudábo te.
content.english: 21:23 I will declare thy name to my brethren: * in the midst of the church will I praise thee.

segments.t: Narrábo nomen tuum frátribus meis: * in médio ecclésiæ laudábo te.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 21(24-32)

content.latin: 21:24 Qui timétis Dóminum, laudáte eum: * univérsum semen Iacob, glorificáte eum.
content.english: 21:24 Ye that fear the Lord, praise him: * all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him.

segments.t: Qui timétis Dóminum, laudáte eum: * univérsum semen Iacob, glorificáte eum.

content.latin: 21:25 Tímeat eum omne semen Israël: * quóniam non sprevit, neque despéxit deprecatiónem páuperis:
content.english: 21:25 Let all the seed of Israel fear him: * because he hath not slighted nor despised the supplication of the poor man.

segments.t: Tímeat eum omne semen Israël: * quóniam non sprevit, neque despéxit deprecatiónem páuperis:

content.latin: 21:25 Nec avértit fáciem suam a me: * et cum clamárem ad eum, exaudívit me.
content.english: 21:25 Neither hath he turned away his face from me: * and when I cried to him he heard me.

segments.t: Nec avértit fáciem suam a me: * et cum clamárem ad eum, exaudívit me.

content.latin: 21:26 Apud te laus mea in ecclésia magna: * vota mea reddam in conspéctu timéntium eum.
content.english: 21:26 With thee is my praise in a great church: * I will pay my vows in the sight of them that fear him.

segments.t: Apud te laus mea in ecclésia magna: * vota mea reddam in conspéctu timéntium eum.

content.latin: 21:27 Edent páuperes, et saturabúntur: et laudábunt Dóminum qui requírunt eum: * vivent corda eórum in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 21:27 The poor shall eat and shall be filled: and they shall praise the Lord that seek him: * their hearts shall live for ever and ever.

segments.t: Edent páuperes, et saturabúntur: et laudábunt Dóminum qui requírunt eum: * vivent corda eórum in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: 21:28 Reminiscéntur et converténtur ad Dóminum * univérsi fines terræ:
content.english: 21:28 All the ends of the earth * shall remember, and shall be converted to the Lord:

segments.t: Reminiscéntur et converténtur ad Dóminum * univérsi fines terræ:

content.latin: 21:28 Et adorábunt in conspéctu eius * univérsæ famíliæ géntium.
content.english: 21:28 And all the kindreds of the Gentiles * shall adore in his sight.

segments.t: Et adorábunt in conspéctu eius * univérsæ famíliæ géntium.

content.latin: 21:29 Quóniam Dómini est regnum: * et ipse dominábitur géntium.
content.english: 21:29 For the kingdom is the Lord’s; * and he shall have dominion over the nations.

segments.t: Quóniam Dómini est regnum: * et ipse dominábitur géntium.

content.latin: 21:30 Manducavérunt et adoravérunt omnes pingues terræ: * in conspéctu eius cadent omnes qui descéndunt in terram.
content.english: 21:30 All the fat ones of the earth have eaten and have adored: * all they that go down to the earth shall fall before him.

segments.t: Manducavérunt et adoravérunt omnes pingues terræ: * in conspéctu eius cadent omnes qui descéndunt in terram.

content.latin: 21:31 Et ánima mea illi vivet: * et semen meum sérviet ipsi.
content.english: 21:31 And to him my soul shall live: * and my seed shall serve him.

segments.t: Et ánima mea illi vivet: * et semen meum sérviet ipsi.

content.latin: 21:32 Annuntiábitur Dómino generátio ventúra: * et annuntiábunt cæli iustítiam eius pópulo qui nascétur, quem fecit Dóminus.
content.english: 21:32 There shall be declared to the Lord a generation to come: * and the heavens shall shew forth his justice to a people that shall be born, which the Lord hath made.

segments.t: Annuntiábitur Dómino generátio ventúra: * et annuntiábunt cæli iustítiam eius pópulo qui nascétur, quem fecit Dóminus.

Ne discédas a me, Dómine: quóniam tribulátio próxima est: quóniam non est qui ádiuvet.

content.latin: Regi sæculórum immortáli et invisíbili, soli Deo honor et glória in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: Now to the king of ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

Eius vero festívitas quarto Nonas Septémbris, quo die munitíssima Budæ arx, sancti Regis ope, ab exércitu Christiáno strénue recuperáta fuit, potíssimum recólitur, ex dispositióne Innocéntii Papæ Undécimi.
content.english: The pagans found him bearing the Sacraments of the Body of Christ, and began to ask him what he was carrying, but he deemed it unseemly to produce pearls before swine, and they maltreated him so with sticks and stones that he gave up the ghost. When they sacrilegiously searched his body, they did not find any trace of the Sacraments of Christ either in his hands or among his clothes, but the Christians took up the body of the martyr and buried it honourably in the cemetery of Callistus.

content.latin: Romæ, via Appia, sancti Tharsícii Acolythi, quem Pagáni, cum inveníssent Córporis Christi Sacraménta portántem, cœpérunt disquírere quid géreret. content.latin: 81:1 Deus stetit in synagóga deórum: * in médio autem deos diiúdicat.

segments.t: Deus stetit in synagóga deórum: * in médio autem deos diiúdicat.

content.latin: 81:2 Úsquequo iudicátis iniquitátem: * et fácies peccatórum súmitis?
content.english: 81:2 How long will you judge unjustly: * and accept the persons of the wicked?

segments.t: Úsquequo iudicátis iniquitátem: * et fácies peccatórum súmitis?

content.latin: 81:3 Iudicáte egéno, et pupíllo: * húmilem, et páuperem iustificáte.
content.english: 81:3 Judge for the needy and fatherless: * do justice to the humble and the poor.

segments.t: Iudicáte egéno, et pupíllo: * húmilem, et páuperem iustificáte.

content.latin: 81:4 Erípite páuperem: * et egénum de manu peccatóris liberáte.
content.english: 81:4 Rescue the poor; * and deliver the needy out of the hand of the sinner.

segments.t: Erípite páuperem: * et egénum de manu peccatóris liberáte.

content.latin: 81:5 Nesciérunt, neque intellexérunt, in ténebris ámbulant: * movebúntur ómnia fundaménta terræ.
content.english: 81:5 They have not known nor understood: they walk on in darkness: * all the foundations of the earth shall be moved.

segments.t: Nesciérunt, neque intellexérunt, in ténebris ámbulant: * movebúntur ómnia fundaménta terræ.

content.latin: 81:6 Ego dixi: Dii estis, * et fílii Excélsi omnes.

content.english: 81:7 But you like men shall die: * and shall fall like one of the princes.

segments.t: Vos autem sicut hómines moriémini: * et sicut unus de princípibus cadétis.

content.latin: 81:8 Surge, Deus, iúdica terram: * quóniam tu hereditábis in ómnibus géntibus.

content.english: 83:2 How lovely are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts! * my soul longeth and fainteth for the courts of the Lord.

segments.t: Quam dilécta tabernácula tua, Dómine virtútum: * concupíscit, et déficit ánima mea in átria Dómini.

content.latin: 83:4 Étenim passer invénit sibi domum: * et turtur nidum sibi, ubi ponat pullos suos.
content.english: 83:4 For the sparrow hath found herself a house, * and the turtledove a nest for herself where she may lay her young ones:

content.english: 83:4 Thy altars, O Lord of hosts, * my king and my God.

content.english: 83:11 I have chosen to be an abject in the house of my God, * rather than to dwell in the tabernacles of sinners.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Rerum, Deus, tenax vigor,
content.english: O strength and stay upholding all creation,

content.latin: Immótus in te pérmanens,
content.english: Who ever dost thyself unmoved abide,

content.latin: Lucis diúrnæ témpora
content.english: Yet day by day the light in due gradation

content.latin: Succéssibus detérminans:
content.english: From hour to hour through all its changes guide:

content.latin: Largíre lumen véspere,
content.english: Grant to life’s day a calm unclouded ending,

content.latin: Quo vita nusquam décidat,
content.english: An eve untouched by shadows of decay,

content.latin: Sed prǽmium mortis sacræ
content.english: The brightness of a holy death-bed blending

content.latin: Perénnis instet glória.
content.english: With dawning glories of th’ eternal day.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: Hear us, O Father, gracious and forgiving,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: And thou, O Christ, the co-eternal Word,

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost, by all things living

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Now and to endless ages art adored.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Misericórdia et véritas * præcédent fáciem tuam, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. Mercy and truth * shall go before thy face, O Lord.

segments.t: Ant.
Misericórdia et véritas * præcédent fáciem tuam, Dómine.
Psalmus 88(2-19)

content.latin: 88:2 Misericórdias Dómini * in ætérnum cantábo.
content.english: 88:2 The mercies of the Lord * I will sing for ever.

segments.t: Misericórdias Dómini * in ætérnum cantábo.

content.latin: 88:2 In generatiónem et generatiónem * annuntiábo veritátem tuam in ore meo.
content.english: 88:2 I will shew forth thy truth with my mouth * to generation and generation.

segments.t: In generatiónem et generatiónem * annuntiábo veritátem tuam in ore meo.

content.latin: 88:3 Quóniam dixísti: In ætérnum misericórdia ædificábitur in cælis: * præparábitur véritas tua in eis.
content.english: 88:3 For thou hast said: Mercy shall be built up for ever in the heavens: * thy truth shall be prepared in them.

segments.t: Quóniam dixísti: In ætérnum misericórdia ædificábitur in cælis: * præparábitur véritas tua in eis.

content.latin: 88:4 Dispósui testaméntum eléctis meis, iurávi David, servo meo: * Usque in ætérnum præparábo semen tuum.
content.english: 88:4 I have made a covenant with my elect: I have sworn to David my servant: * Thy seed will I settle for ever.

segments.t: Dispósui testaméntum eléctis meis, iurávi David, servo meo: * Usque in ætérnum præparábo semen tuum.

content.latin: 88:5 Et ædificábo in generatiónem et generatiónem * sedem tuam.
content.english: 88:5 And I will build up thy throne * unto generation and generation.

segments.t: Et ædificábo in generatiónem et generatiónem * sedem tuam.

content.latin: 88:6 Confitebúntur cæli mirabília tua, Dómine: * étenim veritátem tuam in ecclésia sanctórum.
content.english: 88:6 The heavens shall confess thy wonders, O Lord: * and thy truth in the church of the saints.

segments.t: Confitebúntur cæli mirabília tua, Dómine: * étenim veritátem tuam in ecclésia sanctórum.

content.latin: 88:7 Quóniam quis in núbibus æquábitur Dómino: * símilis erit Deo in fíliis Dei?
content.english: 88:7 For who in the clouds can be compared to the Lord: * or who among the sons of God shall be like to God?

segments.t: Quóniam quis in núbibus æquábitur Dómino: * símilis erit Deo in fíliis Dei?

content.latin: 88:8 Deus, qui glorificátur in consílio sanctórum: * magnus et terríbilis super omnes qui in circúitu eius sunt.
content.english: 88:8 God, who is glorified in the assembly of the saints: * great and terrible above all them that are about him.

segments.t: Deus, qui glorificátur in consílio sanctórum: * magnus et terríbilis super omnes qui in circúitu eius sunt.

content.latin: 88:9 Dómine, Deus virtútum, quis símilis tibi? * potens es, Dómine, et véritas tua in circúitu tuo.
content.english: 88:9 O Lord God of hosts, who is like to thee? * thou art mighty, O Lord, and thy truth is round about thee.

segments.t: Dómine, Deus virtútum, quis símilis tibi? * potens es, Dómine, et véritas tua in circúitu tuo.

content.latin: 88:10 Tu domináris potestáti maris: * motum autem flúctuum eius tu mítigas.
content.english: 88:10 Thou rulest the power of the sea: * and appeasest the motion of the waves thereof.

segments.t: Tu domináris potestáti maris: * motum autem flúctuum eius tu mítigas.

content.latin: 88:11 Tu humiliásti sicut vulnerátum, supérbum: * in brácchio virtútis tuæ dispersísti inimícos tuos.
content.english: 88:11 Thou hast humbled the proud one, as one that is slain: * with the arm of thy strength thou hast scattered thy enemies.

segments.t: Tu humiliásti sicut vulnerátum, supérbum: * in brácchio virtútis tuæ dispersísti inimícos tuos.

content.latin: 88:12 Tui sunt cæli, et tua est terra, orbem terræ et plenitúdinem eius tu fundásti: * aquilónem, et mare tu creásti.
content.english: 88:12 Thine are the heavens, and thine is the earth: the world and the fulness thereof thou hast founded: * the north and the sea thou hast created.

segments.t: Tui sunt cæli, et tua est terra, orbem terræ et plenitúdinem eius tu fundásti: * aquilónem, et mare tu creásti.

content.latin: 88:13 Thabor et Hermon in nómine tuo exsultábunt: * tuum brácchium cum poténtia.
content.english: 88:13 Thabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name: * thy arm is with might.

segments.t: Thabor et Hermon in nómine tuo exsultábunt: * tuum brácchium cum poténtia.

content.latin: 88:14 Firmétur manus tua, et exaltétur déxtera tua: * iustítia et iudícium præparátio sedis tuæ.
content.english: 88:14 Let thy hand be strengthened, and thy right hand exalted: * justice and judgment are the preparation of thy throne.

segments.t: Firmétur manus tua, et exaltétur déxtera tua: * iustítia et iudícium præparátio sedis tuæ.

content.latin: 88:15 Misericórdia et véritas præcédent fáciem tuam: * beátus pópulus, qui scit iubilatiónem.
content.english: 88:15 Mercy and truth shall go before thy face: * blessed is the people that knoweth jubilation.

segments.t: Misericórdia et véritas præcédent fáciem tuam: * beátus pópulus, qui scit iubilatiónem.

content.latin: 88:16 Dómine, in lúmine vultus tui ambulábunt, et in nómine tuo exsultábunt tota die: * et in iustítia tua exaltabúntur.
content.english: 88:16 They shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance: and in thy name they shall rejoice all the day, * and in thy justice they shall be exalted.

segments.t: Dómine, in lúmine vultus tui ambulábunt, et in nómine tuo exsultábunt tota die: * et in iustítia tua exaltabúntur.

content.latin: 88:18 Quóniam glória virtútis eórum tu es: * et in beneplácito tuo exaltábitur cornu nostrum.
content.english: 88:18 For thou art the glory of their strength: * and in thy good pleasure shall our horn be exalted.

segments.t: Quóniam glória virtútis eórum tu es: * et in beneplácito tuo exaltábitur cornu nostrum.

content.latin: 88:19 Quia Dómini est assúmptio nostra, * et Sancti Israël, regis nostri.
content.english: 88:19 For our protection is of the Lord, * and of our king the holy one of Israel.

segments.t: Quia Dómini est assúmptio nostra, * et Sancti Israël, regis nostri.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 88(20-38)

content.latin: 88:20 Tunc locútus es in visióne sanctis tuis, et dixísti: * Pósui adiutórium in poténte: et exaltávi eléctum de plebe mea.
content.english: 88:20 Then thou spokest in a vision to thy saints, and saidst: * I have laid help upon one that is mighty, and have exalted one chosen out of my people.

segments.t: Tunc locútus es in visióne sanctis tuis, et dixísti: * Pósui adiutórium in poténte: et exaltávi eléctum de plebe mea.

content.latin: 88:21 Invéni David, servum meum: * óleo sancto meo unxi eum.
content.english: 88:21 I have found David my servant: * with my holy oil I have anointed him.

segments.t: Invéni David, servum meum: * óleo sancto meo unxi eum.

content.latin: 88:22 Manus enim mea auxiliábitur ei: * et brácchium meum confortábit eum.
content.english: 88:22 For my hand shall help him: * and my arm shall strengthen him.

segments.t: Manus enim mea auxiliábitur ei: * et brácchium meum confortábit eum.

content.latin: 88:23 Nihil profíciet inimícus in eo, * et fílius iniquitátis non appónet nocére ei.
content.english: 88:23 The enemy shall have no advantage over him: * nor the son of iniquity have power to hurt him.

segments.t: Nihil profíciet inimícus in eo, * et fílius iniquitátis non appónet nocére ei.

content.latin: 88:24 Et concídam a fácie ipsíus inimícos eius: * et odiéntes eum in fugam convértam.
content.english: 88:24 And I will cut down his enemies before his face; * and them that hate him I will put to flight.

segments.t: Et concídam a fácie ipsíus inimícos eius: * et odiéntes eum in fugam convértam.

content.latin: 88:25 Et véritas mea, et misericórdia mea cum ipso: * et in nómine meo exaltábitur cornu eius.
content.english: 88:25 And my truth and my mercy shall be with him: * and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

segments.t: Et véritas mea, et misericórdia mea cum ipso: * et in nómine meo exaltábitur cornu eius.

content.latin: 88:26 Et ponam in mari manum eius: * et in flumínibus déxteram eius.
content.english: 88:26 And I will set his hand in the sea; * and his right hand in the rivers.

segments.t: Et ponam in mari manum eius: * et in flumínibus déxteram eius.

content.latin: 88:27 Ipse invocábit me: Pater meus es tu: * Deus meus, et suscéptor salútis meæ.
content.english: 88:27 He shall cry out to me: Thou art my father: * my God, and the support of my salvation.

segments.t: Ipse invocábit me: Pater meus es tu: * Deus meus, et suscéptor salútis meæ.

content.latin: 88:28 Et ego primogénitum ponam illum * excélsum præ régibus terræ.
content.english: 88:28 And I will make him my firstborn, * high above the kings of the earth.

segments.t: Et ego primogénitum ponam illum * excélsum præ régibus terræ.

content.latin: 88:29 In ætérnum servábo illi misericórdiam meam: * et testaméntum meum fidéle ipsi.
content.english: 88:29 I will keep my mercy for him for ever: * and my covenant faithful to him.

segments.t: In ætérnum servábo illi misericórdiam meam: * et testaméntum meum fidéle ipsi.

content.latin: 88:30 Et ponam in sǽculum sǽculi semen eius: * et thronum eius sicut dies cæli.
content.english: 88:30 And I will make his seed to endure for evermore: * and his throne as the days of heaven.

segments.t: Et ponam in sǽculum sǽculi semen eius: * et thronum eius sicut dies cæli.

content.latin: 88:31 Si autem derelíquerint fílii eius legem meam: * et in iudíciis meis non ambuláverint:
content.english: 88:31 And if his children forsake my law, * and walk not in my judgments:

segments.t: Si autem derelíquerint fílii eius legem meam: * et in iudíciis meis non ambuláverint:

content.latin: 88:32 Si iustítias meas profanáverint: * et mandáta mea non custodíerint:
content.english: 88:32 If they profane my justices: * and keep not my commandments:

segments.t: Si iustítias meas profanáverint: * et mandáta mea non custodíerint:

content.latin: 88:33 Visitábo in virga iniquitátes eórum: * et in verbéribus peccáta eórum.
content.english: 88:33 I will visit their iniquities with a rod: *and their sins with stripes.

segments.t: Visitábo in virga iniquitátes eórum: * et in verbéribus peccáta eórum.

content.latin: 88:34 Misericórdiam autem meam non dispérgam ab eo: * neque nocébo in veritáte mea:
content.english: 88:34 But my mercy I will not take away from him: * nor will I suffer my truth to fail.

segments.t: Misericórdiam autem meam non dispérgam ab eo: * neque nocébo in veritáte mea:

content.latin: 88:35 Neque profanábo testaméntum meum: * et quæ procédunt de lábiis meis, non fáciam írrita.
content.english: 88:35 Neither will I profane my covenant: * and the words that proceed from my mouth I will not make void.

segments.t: Neque profanábo testaméntum meum: * et quæ procédunt de lábiis meis, non fáciam írrita.

content.latin: 88:36 Semel iurávi in sancto meo: Si David méntiar: * semen eius in ætérnum manébit.
content.english: 88:36 Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David: * his seed shall endure for ever.

segments.t: Semel iurávi in sancto meo: Si David méntiar: * semen eius in ætérnum manébit.

content.latin: 88:37 Et thronus eius sicut sol in conspéctu meo, * et sicut luna perfécta in ætérnum: et testis in cælo fidélis.
content.english: 88:37 And his throne as the sun before me: * and as the moon perfect for ever, and a faithful witness in heaven.

segments.t: Et thronus eius sicut sol in conspéctu meo, * et sicut luna perfécta in ætérnum: et testis in cælo fidélis.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 88(39-53)

content.latin: 88:39 Tu vero repulísti et despexísti: * distulísti Christum tuum.
content.english: 88:39 But thou hast rejected and despised: * thou hast been angry with thy anointed.

segments.t: Tu vero repulísti et despexísti: * distulísti Christum tuum.

content.latin: 88:40 Evertísti testaméntum servi tui: * profanásti in terra Sanctuárium eius.
content.english: 88:40 Thou hast overthrown the covenant of thy servant: * thou hast profaned his sanctuary on the earth.

segments.t: Evertísti testaméntum servi tui: * profanásti in terra Sanctuárium eius.

content.latin: 88:41 Destruxísti omnes sepes eius: * posuísti firmaméntum eius formídinem.
content.english: 88:41 Thou hast broken down all his hedges: * thou hast made his strength fear.

segments.t: Destruxísti omnes sepes eius: * posuísti firmaméntum eius formídinem.

content.latin: 88:42 Diripuérunt eum omnes transeúntes viam: * factus est oppróbrium vicínis suis.
content.english: 88:42 All that pass by the way have robbed him: * he is become a reproach to his neighbours.

segments.t: Diripuérunt eum omnes transeúntes viam: * factus est oppróbrium vicínis suis.

content.latin: 88:43 Exaltásti déxteram depriméntium eum: * lætificásti omnes inimícos eius.
content.english: 88:43 Thou hast set up the right hand of them that oppress him: * thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

segments.t: Exaltásti déxteram depriméntium eum: * lætificásti omnes inimícos eius.

content.latin: 88:44 Avertísti adiutórium gládii eius: * et non es auxiliátus ei in bello.
content.english: 88:44 Thou hast turned away the help of his sword; * and hast not assisted him in battle.

segments.t: Avertísti adiutórium gládii eius: * et non es auxiliátus ei in bello.

content.latin: 88:45 Destruxísti eum ab emundatióne: * et sedem eius in terram collisísti.
content.english: 88:45 Thou hast made his purification to cease: * and thou hast cast his throne down to the ground.

segments.t: Destruxísti eum ab emundatióne: * et sedem eius in terram collisísti.

content.latin: 88:46 Minorásti dies témporis eius: * perfudísti eum confusióne.
content.english: 88:46 Thou hast shortened the days of his time: * thou hast covered him with confusion.

segments.t: Minorásti dies témporis eius: * perfudísti eum confusióne.

content.latin: 88:47 Úsquequo, Dómine, avértis in finem: * exardéscet sicut ignis ira tua?
content.english: 88:47 How long, O Lord, turnest thou away unto the end? * shall thy anger burn like fire?

segments.t: Úsquequo, Dómine, avértis in finem: * exardéscet sicut ignis ira tua?

content.latin: 88:48 Memoráre quæ mea substántia: * numquid enim vane constituísti omnes fílios hóminum?
content.english: 88:48 Remember what my substance is: * for hast thou made all the children of men in vain?

segments.t: Memoráre quæ mea substántia: * numquid enim vane constituísti omnes fílios hóminum?

content.latin: 88:49 Quis est homo, qui vivet, et non vidébit mortem: * éruet ánimam suam de manu ínferi?
content.english: 88:49 Who is the man that shall live, and not see death: * that shall deliver his soul from the hand of hell?

segments.t: Quis est homo, qui vivet, et non vidébit mortem: * éruet ánimam suam de manu ínferi?

content.latin: 88:50 Ubi sunt misericórdiæ tuæ antíquæ, Dómine, * sicut iurásti David in veritáte tua?
content.english: 88:50 Lord, where are thy ancient mercies, * according to what thou didst swear to David in thy truth?

segments.t: Ubi sunt misericórdiæ tuæ antíquæ, Dómine, * sicut iurásti David in veritáte tua?

content.latin: 88:51 Memor esto, Dómine, oppróbrii servórum tuórum * quod contínui in sinu meo multárum géntium.
content.english: 88:51 Be mindful, O Lord, of the reproach of thy servants * which I have held in my bosom of many nations:

segments.t: Memor esto, Dómine, oppróbrii servórum tuórum * quod contínui in sinu meo multárum géntium.

content.latin: 88:52 Quod exprobravérunt inimíci tui, Dómine, * quod exprobravérunt commutatiónem Christi tui.
content.english: 88:52 Wherewith thy enemies have reproached, O Lord; * wherewith they have reproached the change of thy anointed.

segments.t: Quod exprobravérunt inimíci tui, Dómine, * quod exprobravérunt commutatiónem Christi tui.

content.latin: 88:53 Benedíctus Dóminus in ætérnum: * fiat, fiat.
content.english: 88:53 Blessed be the Lord for evermore. * So be it. So be it.

segments.t: Benedíctus Dóminus in ætérnum: * fiat, fiat.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Misericórdia et véritas præcédent fáciem tuam, Dómine.
content.english: Ant. Mercy and truth shall go before thy face, O Lord.

segments.t: Ant.
Misericórdia et véritas præcédent fáciem tuam, Dómine.

content.latin: In timóre incolátus vestri témpore conversámini: sciéntes quod non corruptibílibus auro vel argénto redémpti estis, sed pretióso sánguine quasi Agni immaculáti Christi.
content.english: Converse in fear during the time of your sojourning here. Knowing that you were not redeemed with corruptible things as gold or silver, but with the precious blood of Christ.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟.br. Rédime me, Dómine, * Et miserére mei.
content.english: ℟.br. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.

segments.t: ℟.br.
Rédime me, Dómine, * Et miserére mei.

content.latin: ℟. Rédime me, Dómine, * Et miserére mei.
content.english: ℟. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.

segments.t: Rédime me, Dómine, * Et miserére mei.

content.latin: ℣. Pes enim meus stetit in via recta.
content.english: ℣. For my feet stood in the right way.

segments.t: Pes enim meus stetit in via recta.

content.latin: ℟. Et miserére mei.
content.english: ℟. And have mercy on me.

segments.t: Et miserére mei.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Rédime me, Dómine, * Et miserére mei.
content.english: ℟. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.

segments.t: Rédime me, Dómine, * Et miserére mei.

content.latin: ℣. Ab occúltis meis munda me, Dómine.
content.english: ℣. From my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord.

segments.t: Ab occúltis meis munda me, Dómine.

content.latin: ℟. Et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.
content.english: ℟. And from those of others spare thy servant.

segments.t: Et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Deus, qui virginálem aulam beátæ Maríæ, in qua habitáres, elígere dignátus es: da, quǽsumus; ut, sua nos defensióne munítos, iucúndos fácias suæ interésse festivitáti:
content.english: O God, Who wast pleased to choose for thy dwelling-place the maiden palace of Blessed Mary, grant, we beseech thee, that her protection may shield us, and make us glad in her commemoration.

content.latin: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Assúmpta est María in cælum: * gaudent Angeli, laudántes benedícunt Dóminum.
content.english: Ant. Mary hath been taken to heaven; * the Angels rejoice; they praise and bless the Lord.

segments.t: Ant.
Assúmpta est María in cælum: * gaudent Angeli, laudántes benedícunt Dóminum.

content.latin: Psalmus 109 [1]
content.english: Psalm 109 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 109

content.latin: 109:1 Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:
content.english: 109:1 The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand:

segments.t: Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:

content.latin: 109:1 Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.
content.english: 109:1 Until I make thy enemies * thy footstool.

segments.t: Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.

content.latin: 109:2 Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
content.english: 109:2 The Lord will send forth the sceptre of thy power out of Sion: * rule thou in the midst of thy enemies.

segments.t: Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.

content.latin: 109:3 Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
content.english: 109:3 With thee is the principality in the day of thy strength: in the brightness of the saints: * from the womb before the day star I begot thee.

segments.t: Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.

content.latin: 109:4 Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
content.english: 109:4 The Lord hath sworn, and he will not repent: * Thou art a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech.

segments.t: Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.

content.latin: 109:5 Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
content.english: 109:5 The Lord at thy right hand * hath broken kings in the day of his wrath.

segments.t: Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.

content.latin: 109:6 Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.
content.english: 109:6 He shall judge among nations, he shall fill ruins: * he shall crush the heads in the land of many.

segments.t: Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.

content.latin: 109:7 De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.
content.english: 109:7 He shall drink of the torrent in the way: * therefore shall he lift up the head.

segments.t: De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.

content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Ant. María Virgo assúmpta est * ad æthéreum thálamum, in quo Rex regum stelláto sedet sólio.
content.english: Ant. The Virgin Mary hath been taken into the chamber on high, * where the King of kings sitteth on a throne amid the stars.

segments.t: Ant.
María Virgo assúmpta est * ad æthéreum thálamum, in quo Rex regum stelláto sedet sólio.

content.latin: Psalmus 112 [2]
content.english: Psalm 112 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 112

content.latin: 112:1 Laudáte, púeri, Dóminum: * laudáte nomen Dómini.
content.english: 112:1 Praise the Lord, ye children: * praise ye the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Laudáte, púeri, Dóminum: * laudáte nomen Dómini.

content.latin: 112:2 (fit reverentia) Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
content.english: 112:2 (bow head) Blessed be the name of the Lord, * from henceforth now and for ever.

segments.t: 112:2 (fit reverentia)
Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.

content.latin: 112:3 A solis ortu usque ad occásum, * laudábile nomen Dómini.
content.english: 112:3 From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, * the name of the Lord is worthy of praise.

segments.t: A solis ortu usque ad occásum, * laudábile nomen Dómini.

content.latin: 112:4 Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, * et super cælos glória eius.
content.english: 112:4 The Lord is high above all nations; * and his glory above the heavens.

segments.t: Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, * et super cælos glória eius.

content.latin: 112:5 Quis sicut Dóminus, Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, * et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?
content.english: 112:5 Who is as the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high: * and looketh down on the low things in heaven and in earth?

segments.t: Quis sicut Dóminus, Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, * et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?

content.latin: 112:7 Súscitans a terra ínopem, * et de stércore érigens páuperem:
content.english: 112:7 Raising up the needy from the earth, * and lifting up the poor out of the dunghill:

segments.t: Súscitans a terra ínopem, * et de stércore érigens páuperem:

content.latin: 112:8 Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, * cum princípibus pópuli sui.
content.english: 112:8 That he may place him with princes, * with the princes of his people.

segments.t: Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, * cum princípibus pópuli sui.

content.latin: 112:9 Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, * matrem filiórum lætántem.
content.english: 112:9 Who maketh a barren woman to dwell in a house, * the joyful mother of children.

segments.t: Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, * matrem filiórum lætántem.

content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Ant. In odórem * unguentórum tuórum cúrrimus: adolescéntulæ dilexérunt te nimis.
content.english: Ant. We run after thee, on the scent of thy perfumes * the virgins love thee heartily.

segments.t: Ant.
In odórem * unguentórum tuórum cúrrimus: adolescéntulæ dilexérunt te nimis.

content.latin: Psalmus 121 [3]
content.english: Psalm 121 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 121

content.latin: 121:1 Lætátus sum in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi: * In domum Dómini íbimus.
content.english: 121:1 I rejoiced at the things that were said to me: * We shall go into the house of the Lord.

segments.t: Lætátus sum in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi: * In domum Dómini íbimus.

content.latin: 121:2 Stantes erant pedes nostri, * in átriis tuis, Ierúsalem.
content.english: 121:2 Our feet were standing * in thy courts, O Jerusalem.

segments.t: Stantes erant pedes nostri, * in átriis tuis, Ierúsalem.

content.latin: 121:3 Ierúsalem, quæ ædificátur ut cívitas: * cuius participátio eius in idípsum.
content.english: 121:3 Jerusalem, which is built as a city, * which is compact together.

segments.t: Ierúsalem, quæ ædificátur ut cívitas: * cuius participátio eius in idípsum.

content.latin: 121:4 Illuc enim ascendérunt tribus, tribus Dómini: * testimónium Israël ad confiténdum nómini Dómini.
content.english: 121:4 For thither did the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord: * the testimony of Israel, to praise the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Illuc enim ascendérunt tribus, tribus Dómini: * testimónium Israël ad confiténdum nómini Dómini.

content.latin: 121:5 Quia illic sedérunt sedes in iudício, * sedes super domum David.
content.english: 121:5 Because their seats have sat in judgment, * seats upon the house of David.

segments.t: Quia illic sedérunt sedes in iudício, * sedes super domum David.

content.latin: 121:6 Rogáte quæ ad pacem sunt Ierúsalem: * et abundántia diligéntibus te:
content.english: 121:6 Pray ye for the things that are for the peace of Jerusalem: * and abundance for them that love thee.

segments.t: Rogáte quæ ad pacem sunt Ierúsalem: * et abundántia diligéntibus te:

content.latin: 121:7 Fiat pax in virtúte tua: * et abundántia in túrribus tuis.
content.english: 121:7 Let peace be in thy strength: * and abundance in thy towers.

segments.t: Fiat pax in virtúte tua: * et abundántia in túrribus tuis.

content.latin: 121:8 Propter fratres meos, et próximos meos, * loquébar pacem de te:
content.english: 121:8 For the sake of my brethren, and of my neighbours, * I spoke peace of thee.

segments.t: Propter fratres meos, et próximos meos, * loquébar pacem de te:

content.latin: 121:9 Propter domum Dómini, Dei nostri, * quæsívi bona tibi.
content.english: 121:9 Because of the house of the Lord our God, * I have sought good things for thee.

segments.t: Propter domum Dómini, Dei nostri, * quæsívi bona tibi.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

segments.t: Ant.
In odórem unguentórum tuórum cúrrimus: adolescéntulæ dilexérunt te nimis.

content.latin: Ant. Benedícta * fília tu a Dómino: quia per te fructum vitæ communicávimus.
content.english: Ant. Blessed of the Lord art thou, O daughter, * for by thee we have been given to eat of the fruit (of the tree) of Life.

segments.t: Ant.
Benedícta * fília tu a Dómino: quia per te fructum vitæ communicávimus.

content.latin: Psalmus 126 [4]
content.english: Psalm 126 [4]

segments.t: Psalmus 126

content.latin: 126:1 Nisi Dóminus ædificáverit domum, * in vanum laboravérunt qui ædíficant eam.
content.english: 126:1 Unless the Lord build the house, * they labour in vain that build it.

segments.t: Nisi Dóminus ædificáverit domum, * in vanum laboravérunt qui ædíficant eam.

content.latin: 126:1 Nisi Dóminus custodíerit civitátem, * frustra vígilat qui custódit eam.
content.english: 126:1 Unless the Lord keep the city, * he watcheth in vain that keepeth it.

segments.t: Nisi Dóminus custodíerit civitátem, * frustra vígilat qui custódit eam.

content.latin: 126:2 Vanum est vobis ante lucem súrgere: * súrgite postquam sedéritis, qui manducátis panem dolóris.
content.english: 126:2 It is vain for you to rise before light, * rise ye after you have sitten, you that eat the bread of sorrow.

segments.t: Vanum est vobis ante lucem súrgere: * súrgite postquam sedéritis, qui manducátis panem dolóris.

content.latin: 126:2 Cum déderit diléctis suis somnum: * ecce heréditas Dómini fílii: merces, fructus ventris.
content.english: 126:2 When he shall give sleep to his beloved, * behold the inheritance of the Lord are children: the reward, the fruit of the womb.

segments.t: Cum déderit diléctis suis somnum: * ecce heréditas Dómini fílii: merces, fructus ventris.

content.latin: 126:4 Sicut sagíttæ in manu poténtis: * ita fílii excussórum.
content.english: 126:4 As arrows in the hand of the mighty, * so the children of them that have been shaken.

segments.t: Sicut sagíttæ in manu poténtis: * ita fílii excussórum.

content.latin: 126:5 Beátus vir, qui implévit desidérium suum ex ipsis: * non confundétur cum loquétur inimícis suis in porta.
content.english: 126:5 Blessed is the man that hath filled the desire with them; * he shall not be confounded when he shall speak to his enemies in the gate.

segments.t: Beátus vir, qui implévit desidérium suum ex ipsis: * non confundétur cum loquétur inimícis suis in porta.

content.latin: Ant. Pulchra es * et decóra, fília Ierúsalem, terríbilis ut castrórum ácies ordináta.
content.english: Ant. Fair and comely art thou, O daughter of Jerusalem, * terrible as a fenced camp set in battle array.

segments.t: Ant.
Pulchra es * et decóra, fília Ierúsalem, terríbilis ut castrórum ácies ordináta.

content.latin: Psalmus 147 [5]
content.english: Psalm 147 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 147

content.latin: 147:1 Lauda, Ierúsalem, Dóminum: * lauda Deum tuum, Sion.
content.english: 147:1 Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem: * praise thy God, O Sion.

segments.t: Lauda, Ierúsalem, Dóminum: * lauda Deum tuum, Sion.

content.latin: 147:2 Quóniam confortávit seras portárum tuárum: * benedíxit fíliis tuis in te.
content.english: 147:2 Because he hath strengthened the bolts of thy gates * he hath blessed thy children within thee.

segments.t: Quóniam confortávit seras portárum tuárum: * benedíxit fíliis tuis in te.

content.latin: 147:3 Qui pósuit fines tuos pacem: * et ádipe fruménti sátiat te.
content.english: 147:3 Who hath placed peace in thy borders: * and filleth thee with the fat of corn.

segments.t: Qui pósuit fines tuos pacem: * et ádipe fruménti sátiat te.

content.latin: 147:4 Qui emíttit elóquium suum terræ: * velóciter currit sermo eius.
content.english: 147:4 Who sendeth forth his speech to the earth: * his word runneth swiftly.

segments.t: Qui emíttit elóquium suum terræ: * velóciter currit sermo eius.

content.latin: 147:5 Qui dat nivem sicut lanam: * nébulam sicut cínerem spargit.
content.english: 147:5 Who giveth snow like wool: * scattereth mists like ashes.

segments.t: Qui dat nivem sicut lanam: * nébulam sicut cínerem spargit.

content.latin: 147:6 Mittit crystállum suam sicut buccéllas: * ante fáciem frígoris eius quis sustinébit?
content.english: 147:6 He sendeth his crystal like morsels: * who shall stand before the face of his cold?

segments.t: Mittit crystállum suam sicut buccéllas: * ante fáciem frígoris eius quis sustinébit?

content.latin: 147:7 Emíttet verbum suum, et liquefáciet ea: * flabit spíritus eius, et fluent aquæ.
content.english: 147:7 He shall send out his word, and shall melt them: * his wind shall blow, and the waters shall run.

segments.t: Emíttet verbum suum, et liquefáciet ea: * flabit spíritus eius, et fluent aquæ.

content.latin: 147:8 Qui annúntiat verbum suum Iacob: * iustítias, et iudícia sua Israël.
content.english: 147:8 Who declareth his word to Jacob: * his justices and his judgments to Israel.

segments.t: Qui annúntiat verbum suum Iacob: * iustítias, et iudícia sua Israël.

content.latin: 147:9 Non fecit táliter omni natióni: * et iudícia sua non manifestávit eis.
content.english: 147:9 He hath not done in like manner to every nation: * and his judgments he hath not made manifest to them.

segments.t: Non fecit táliter omni natióni: * et iudícia sua non manifestávit eis.

content.latin: Iudith 13:22-23

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris: et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem: sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation: But deliver us from evil. Amen.

content.latin: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere: percutit sibi pectus mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.
content.english: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and to all the Saints, that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed: strikes his breast through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and all the Saints, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

segments.t: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere:

content.latin: 90:9 Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: * Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.
content.english: 90:9 Because thou, O Lord, art my hope: * thou hast made the most High thy refuge.

segments.t: Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: * Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.

content.latin: 90:10 Non accédet ad te malum: * et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.
content.english: 90:10 There shall no evil come to thee: * nor shall the scourge come near thy dwelling.

segments.t: Non accédet ad te malum: * et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.

content.latin: 90:11 Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te: * ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
content.english: 90:11 For he hath given his angels charge over thee; * to keep thee in all thy ways.

segments.t: Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te: * ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.

content.latin: 90:12 In mánibus portábunt te: * ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
content.english: 90:12 In their hands they shall bear thee up: * lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

segments.t: In mánibus portábunt te: * ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.

content.latin: 90:13 Super áspidem, et basilíscum ambulábis: * et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.
content.english: 90:13 Thou shalt walk upon the asp and the basilisk: * and thou shalt trample under foot the lion and the dragon.

segments.t: Super áspidem, et basilíscum ambulábis: * et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.

content.latin: 90:14 Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: * prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.
content.english: 90:14 Because he hoped in me I will deliver him: * I will protect him because he hath known my name.

segments.t: Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: * prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.

content.latin: 90:15 Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: * cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.
content.english: 90:15 He shall cry to me, and I will hear him: * I am with him in tribulation, I will deliver him, and I will glorify him.

segments.t: Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: * cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.

content.latin: 90:16 Longitúdine diérum replébo eum: * et osténdam illi salutáre meum.
content.english: 90:16 I will fill him with length of days; * and I will shew him my salvation.

segments.t: Longitúdine diérum replébo eum: * et osténdam illi salutáre meum.

content.english: Before the ending of the day,

content.latin: Rerum Creátor, póscimus,
content.english: Creator of the world, we pray

content.latin: Ut pro tua cleméntia
content.english: That with thy wonted favor thou

content.latin: Sis præsul et custódia.
content.english: Wouldst be our guard and keeper now.

content.latin: Procul recédant sómnia,
content.english: From all ill dreams defend our eyes,

content.latin: Et nóctium phantásmata;

content.latin: Hostémque nostrum cómprime,

content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Vísita, quǽsumus, Dómine, habitatiónem istam, et omnes insídias inimíci ab ea longe repélle: Ángeli tui sancti hábitent in ea, qui nos in pace custódiant; et benedíctio tua sit super nos semper.
content.english: Visit, we beseech thee, O Lord, this dwelling, and drive far from it the snares of the enemy; let thy holy angels dwell herein to preserve us in peace, and let thy blessing be always upon us.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.english: ℟. Amen.

Benedícat et custódiat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus, ✠ Pater, et Fílius, et Spíritus Sanctus.

content.latin: Salve, Regína, mater misericórdiæ;
content.english: Hail holy Queen, Mother of Mercy,

content.latin: vita, dulcédo et spes nóstra, salve.
content.english: our life, our sweetness, and our hope.

content.latin: Ad te clamámus éxsules fílii Hevæ.
content.english: To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve.

content.latin: Ad te suspirámus geméntes et flentes
content.english: To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping

content.latin: In hac lacrimárum valle.
content.english: In this valley of tears.

content.latin: Eia ergo, advocáta nostra,
content.english: Turn then, most gracious Advocate,

content.latin: illos tuos misericórdes óculos ad nos convérte.
content.english: thine eyes of mercy toward us.

content.latin: Et Iesum, benedíctum fructum ventris tui,
content.english: And after this our exile show unto us

content.latin: nobis post hoc exsílium osténde.
content.english: the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

content.latin: O clemens, o pia, o dulcis Virgo María.
content.english: O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

content.latin: ℣. Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
content.english: ℣. Pray for us, O Holy Mother of God.

segments.t: Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génetrix.

content.latin: ℟. Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.
content.english: ℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

segments.t: Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui gloriósæ Vírginis Matris Maríæ corpus et ánimam, ut dignum Fílii tui habitáculum éffici mererétur, Spíritu Sancto cooperánte, præparásti: da, ut, cuius commemoratióne lætámur, eius pia intercessióne, ab instántibus malis et a morte perpétua liberémur. Per eúndem Christum Dóminum nostrum. Amen.
content.english: O almighty, everlasting God, who by the cooperation of the Holy Spirit, didst prepare the body and soul of Mary, glorious Virgin and Mother, to become a worthy dwelling for Thy Son; grant that we who rejoice in her commemoration may, by her gracious intercession, be delivered from present evils and from everlasting death. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.
content.english: ℣. May the divine assistance ✠ remain with us always.

segments.t: Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.

content.english: ℟. Amen.
